create_TrajectoryFrame_from_atoms: create a TrajectoryFrame from an ASE Atoms object with step number and simulation time
convert_TrajectoryFrame_to_dict: convert a TrajectoryFrame dataclass instance to a dictionary for Parquet serialization

flush_parquet_trajectory_buffer: flush buffered trajectory frames to disk as a new Parquet row group with zstd compression
